avatarProps.description: Array of avatars rendered by the group.

items.description: Avatar item. Mirrors the avatar component's props, using initials/initialsClassName in place of value/contentClassName, with no variant (auto-detected).

initials.description: Initials text for non-image avatars (passed as the avatar's value prop).

initialsClassName.description: Additional classes for the non-image avatar content container (passed as the avatar's contentClassName prop).

overlap.description: When true, avatars overlap each other in the group.

stacked.description: When true, avatars are stacked vertically.
